When graduation comes in _graduate we make a call to _createPairAndSwapRemaining, inside that function we try to add liquidity to the pair by calling ` uniV2Router.addLiquidity`, however given the attacker initiated the attack before that, the call will fail, making the whole transaction revert, disabling graduation forever.

There is no way that anybody moves out token into the pair either, if somebody tries to move it in launchpad and set the final recipient as the pair, we still revert as the function _assertValidRecipient makes sure the final recipient is not the pair.
